title: San Francisco homes listing $250,000 or more of pay to related individuals, 2015 to 2025
question: In which years did San Francisco homes list large salary, wage or bonus payments to related individuals?
finding: 3 home-years: San Francisco Health Care 2020, $1.4 million to 1 related person (net income $2.8 million); San Francisco Health Care 2022, $1.3 million to 2 related people (net income $446,558); San Francisco Health Care & Rehab 2023, $1.7 million to 2 related people (net income $260,714).
how: Related-party lines whose description is pay, salary, wages or bonus and whose party is not a company (the same test as the case screen ltc-related-individual-pay). People are counted, never named.
limits: Owners who work in a home may be paid for that work; the report requires the pay to be disclosed. Medi-Cal caps what it recognises for owner compensation.

sources.t: California Department of Health Care Access and Information (HCAI), Long-Term Care Facility Integrated Disclosure and Medi-Cal Cost Report, complete data sets 2015 to 2018, 2020 and 2021 (audited), with the 2019 and 2022 to 2025 sets
HCAI, long-term care financial pivot profiles 2012 to 2018 and 2023 to 2025, the 2019 to 2023 trend pivot and the 2014 and 2015 selected files
HCAI, page-column-line labels for the 2018 form and the 2001-2019 and 2020-current complete data-file documentation
